findings.title: Toggle while daemon down or between polls uploads disabled-period content
findings.problem: The off edge exists only in the in-memory analyticsState. If analytics are turned off and back on while the daemon is down, or between two polls, no off edge is seen: no forward-only baseline is set and the start-up reconcile (or normal polling) delivers chat content written while analytics were disabled.
findings.impact: Violates the 'disable stops everything, enable is forward-only' decision for the daemon-restart and fast-toggle cases; chat content written while disabled can be uploaded. Reachability of the daemon-down path was not fully confirmed, so graded major.
findings.recommendation: Persist the disable time (for example disabledAt in claude-analytics.json) and, at daemon start and on every poll, rebase known records and the activity gate on it so an unobserved off-then-on still becomes forward-only.

fix.change: Records carry the collectionGeneration they were last synced under; a record stamped with another generation (daemon down, or off+on between polls) is rebased forward-only on retrack and at the start-up flush, and a generation change seen while on is treated as an enable edge.
fix.test: DesktopTelemetryRuntime.test.ts 'a toggle no poll observed' (3 tests) and analytics-switch.test.ts checkpoint fields

findings.title: Forward-only rebase skipped when older baseline pending
findings.problem: retrackSession rebases a known record on forwardOnlyFrom only when runtimeCheckpoint.baselineCutoffMs is undefined. A record that still holds an older unapplied baselineCutoffMs (for example kept because subagentsIncomplete, or after a crash) keeps it and is never moved to the enable time.
findings.impact: Content written while analytics were off, after the older baseline, is applied and uploaded after re-enable. The condition is narrow and its reachability was unconfirmed, so graded major.
findings.recommendation: Rebase when the pending baselineCutoffMs is older than forwardOnlyFrom (use the later of the two) instead of only when it is undefined.

fix.change: Rebase on retrack when the pending baselineCutoffMs is absent or older than the cutoff, using the later of the two.
fix.test: DesktopTelemetryRuntime.test.ts 'moves a known record holding an older pending baseline to the enable time'

findings.title: DesktopTelemetryRuntime.ts exceeds the 500-line limit
findings.problem: code-quality.md requires files under 500 lines; this change adds about 72 lines (analytics switch state, checkAnalyticsSwitch, trackedActivity, forward-only rebase) and takes the file from 496 to 568 lines.
findings.impact: The documented file-size rule is newly broken by this change and the class keeps accreting responsibilities.
findings.recommendation: Move the analytics-switch edge handling (checkAnalyticsSwitch, trackedActivity and its state fields) into a small collaborator such as analytics-switch.ts or a sibling class so the file returns under 500 lines.
